summary: Remove at most one matching listener, choosing the most recently added duplicate, without altering an emit already in progress.

target.notes: Must match Node duplicate-removal order, once-wrapper matching, 'removeListener' meta-event behavior, and snapshot semantics for an emit already underway.

caveats: Removing a listener during emit only affects later emits.
Listener identity is reference identity; do not remove structurally equivalent delegates.

tests.name: remove during emit affects next emit
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); const out=[]; const b=()=>out.push('b'); e.on('x',()=>{out.push('a');e.removeListener('x',b)}); e.on('x',b); e.emit('x'); e.emit('x'); console.log(out.join(','));

tests.name: most recent duplicate removed
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; function f(){n++} e.on('x',f); e.once('x',f); e.removeListener('x',f); e.emit('x'); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 2 because the once registration was the most recent and was removed
